headline: Mother and daughter killed in head-on collision in Chakaria
summary: A passenger bus and a private car collided on the Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway, leaving two members of the same family dead.
details: A head-on collision between a passenger bus and a private car in Chakaria, Cox's Bazar, has left a mother and her 10-year-old daughter dead.
The accident occurred around 3:30 PM on Wednesday (October 28) at a bend in the road near the Amtala hill in the Baniarchhara area of the upazila.
The deceased have been identified as Ismat Ara (55) and her daughter Aisha (10), both residents of the Halishahar area of Chattogram.
Two others were injured in the crash: the private car driver, Ashikur Rahman (27), and Ismat Ara's son, Samrat (30).

According to Jakibul Islam, In-charge of the Chiringa Highway Police Station, a bus belonging to Shadhin Travels was traveling from Chattogram to Cox's Bazar when it collided with the oncoming private car.
Police have seized both the bus and the private car. The bodies of the victims were taken to the Chakaria Upazila Health Complex.
Following a request from the family, the police are processing the handover of the bodies without an autopsy.

headline_marked: Farmer [[killed in Chattogram after refusing extortion]]
headline: Farmer killed in Chattogram after refusing extortion
summary: A 50-year-old farmer's body was found on a road in Rangunia, with both hands severed up to the elbows.
details: Police recovered the body of 50-year-old Nezam Uddin from the Kalichhari Bridge area of Mirkhil village in Rangunia, Chattogram, on Wednesday morning.
The victim's two hands were found severed up to the elbows and lying next to the body on a paved road.
Nezam Uddin, a farmer and day laborer, had gone to guard his paddy field from wild elephants on Tuesday afternoon but failed to return home.
Family members searched for him on Wednesday morning and discovered his body approximately 1.5 kilometers away from his field.
A relative, Nurul Alam, alleged that terrorists had recently demanded extortion money from Nezam regarding the construction of a house.
The family believes the victim was brutally killed because he refused to pay the extortion money.
South Rangunia Police Station OC Mo. Hilal Uddin Ahmed stated that the victim died from excessive blood loss after his hands were severed with sharp weapons.
Police have sent the body for an autopsy and are continuing their investigation to identify and arrest the perpetrators.
